November 19, 2026


Future scientists, engineers, operators, leaders and innovators spent the day with us yesterday! Grade 9 students joined their parents and guardians for Take Your Kids to Work Day at our Saskatoon corporate office, Cameco Fuel Manufacturing and Port Hope Conversion Facility, participating in science and safety demonstrations, tours, career activities and more. Thanks to everyone who helped showcase the people and careers that power our business. Who knows? We may have met a few future Cameco employees. #TakeYourKidsToWorkDay[#FutureLeaders](https://facebook.com/hashtag/FutureLeaders)[#MiningCareers](https://facebook.com/hashtag/MiningCareers)
